note: RBA Statistical Table F8 - Personal Lending Rates, series FLRPFOFTT 'Lending rates; Personal credit; Outstanding; Fixed-term loans; Total', observed 31 Jul 2026 and published 07 Sep 2026. This is used as the EIR proxy for personal_loans because the RBA's Table F5 personal term-loan series were discontinued from the April 2020 release and RBA states alternative personal lending-rate series are published in Table F8; it is a published average actual rate for personal fixed-term credit outstanding, not a NAB-specific loan-level EIR.

RBA Statistical Table F5 - Indicator Lending Rates, series FILRHLBVD 'Lending rates; Housing loans; Banks; Variable; Discounted; Owner-occupier', observed 31 Aug 2026 and published 07 Sep 2026. This is used as the EIR proxy for mortgages because it is the current RBA-published owner-occupier variable housing-loan indicator rate closest to this segment, not a NAB-specific loan-level EIR.
